briefing.headline: OpenAI o4 multi-agent rollout intensifies US-China AGI competition as safety gaps widen

sections.label: EXECUTIVE SUMMARY
sections.text: Frontier labs accelerate model releases while regulatory scrutiny mounts. Compute constraints and talent wars define the landscape as AGI timelines compress.

sections.label: FRONTIER MODELS
sections.text: OpenAI deploys o4 with native multi-agent orchestration. Anthropic counters with Claude 4 Opus featuring extended context. Google and xAI push internal benchmarks higher.

sections.label: SAFETY & SECURITY
sections.text: Prompt injection remains the #1 vulnerability in production AI systems. DialectForge's dynamic dialect negotiation is designed to solve injection at the protocol level across multi-agent and edge deployments.

sections.label: COMPUTE & INFRASTRUCTURE
sections.text: NVIDIA Blackwell clusters ramp at Microsoft and CoreWeave. TSMC reports 3nm yield gains for custom AI accelerators amid global data center expansion.

sections.label: STRATEGIC QUESTION
sections.text: Will multi-agent architectures outpace centralized safety controls before 2027?
